title: Privacy-Preserving Background Alerts & Historical Audit Logs Archive
summary: Enhanced phone number privacy across the entire platform by ensuring recipient contact numbers are kept completely confidential and never rendered on UI banners, modals, or toasts. Alerts dispatch silently in the background to verified mobile recipients. Introduced a dedicated Historical Alert Logs audit archive (/api/linepulse/alerts/sms/history) with full movement criteria, whale dollar divergence telemetry, and risk notes.

changes.description: Zero UI Exposure: Stripped phone number from all client-rendered banners, dialogs, status badges, and inspection tools while maintaining active background carrier dispatch.
Historical Alert Logs Archive: Dedicated view and audit viewer tab logging every triggered line shift, total swing, and whale money alert with timestamps and risk telemetry.
Fail-Safe Traffic & Network Handlers: Added resilient try/catch fallbacks to traffic tracking endpoints to prevent unhandled fetch rejections.

title: Prominent Line & Money Movement Alerts, SMS Text Dispatcher & Recharts Trends
summary: Introduced a prominent critical line and whale money movement alert banner at the top of the main LinePulse page, featuring specific risk warning analyses (Key Number Hook risk, Reverse Line traps, late injury/inactives, and vig tax). Built an interactive SMS text dispatcher (/api/linepulse/alerts/sms) with live smartphone screen preview and real carrier gateway dispatch. Created a complete Recharts performance visualization tracking cumulative unit bankroll curves, win rate % vs. break-even thresholds, and slate-by-slate win/loss distributions.

changes.description: Prominent Alert Banner: Glowing high-urgency strobe alert at top of main page detecting massive line steam (e.g. Bills +4.5 to +3.5) and whale handle divergence ($16.4M handle, 68% dollars).
Risk Analysis Engine: Specific warnings for Key Number hook losses (+3.5 vs +3.0), Reverse Line traps, late inactive timing, and vig price gouging.
Real-Time SMS Text Dispatcher: Express API (/api/linepulse/alerts/sms) logging notifications with phone number storage and authentic mobile phone message preview.
Recharts Performance Trends: Cumulative profit curves (+15.60u net), win rate % margins above break-even, and slate decision distribution stacked bars.

title: Sports Analysts Consensus, Contrarian Fade Radar & Header Restructure
summary: Brought in sports media analyst predictions across major networks (ESPN, CBS Sports, FOX, PFF, Sharp Football) to compare against public ticket counts and sharp whale dollars. Integrated Contrarian Gambling Theory to automatically detect extreme consensus traps (80%+ pundit chalk) and trigger opposing high-value fade recommendations. Re-aligned the hub header to position navigation and action buttons neatly below the summary description text.

changes.description: Header Redesign: Brought navigation and action buttons directly below the project summary text, eliminating awkward horizontal stretching.
Sports Analysts Consensus & Contrarian Radar: Side-by-side comparison of 10 media analysts vs. public tickets vs. sharp syndicate dollars with Echo Chamber Scores (0-100) and automated fade triggers.

Venue & Matchup Accuracy: Corrected Buffalo Bills @ Los Angeles Rams designation at SoFi Stadium, correctly treating Buffalo as a Road Underdog catching the key +3.5 field goal hook against public home Rams chalk.

title: Bet Recommendations Tracker, Pattern AI Learning Engine & 7-Day Teaser Window
summary: Introduced complete win/loss ledger tracking for all betting recommendations across the 4 daily tiers (1 Single Game, 1 Parlay, 1 3-team +10 tease, 1 4-team +13 tease) and Prime 1-Game blueprints. Performance resets to 0-0 with live tracking starting as of today (October 12, 2026). Features an adaptive pattern machine learning feedback engine that dynamically tunes strategy weights based on real incoming game outcomes (whale divergence, high-wind unders, key number threshold crossings). Expanded teaser rules to allow pairings spanning any 2 days across the upcoming 7-day schedule period.

changes.description: Recommendations Ledger & Settlement: Clean live tracking starting as of today with 0 settled bets, 0.00 Units, and 0 win streak across 5 active pending recommendations for tonight's slate.

Adaptive Pattern Learning Engine: Evaluates 8 structural market signals against settled outcomes and calculates dynamic model weights (e.g., Whale Inflow, High-Wind Unders, Key Number Teasers) as games conclude.

7-Day Teaser Schedule Window: Expanded teaser recommendations so they can span any 2 days in the upcoming 7-day schedule (e.g. Tonight Oct 12 & Sunday Oct 18 Showcase), crossing key NFL margins with double-digit safety cushions.
Interactive Slate Simulation & Export: Simulate game results to watch the model auto-grade and re-tune future strategy weights in real time; one-click CSV export.

title: Project #4: LinePulse — Sports Betting Sharp Lines & 1-Game Strategy
summary: Launched Project #4: LinePulse. Aggregates publicly available betting lines across 8 top books (DraftKings, FanDuel, Circa, Pinnacle, BetMGM, Caesars). Compares odds, tracks total bets placed vs. total dollars wagered to isolate sharp money divergence, graphs chronological line movement, and algorithmically identifies 1 Game with 1 Multi-Leg Strategy with positive expected value (+EV), focusing on NFL football while analyzing all major US sports.

changes.description: Multi-Sportsbook Consensus Engine: Scrapes and compares spreads, moneylines, and game totals across DraftKings, FanDuel, Circa Sports, Pinnacle, BetMGM, and Caesars with best-price highlights.
Public vs. Sharp Divergence Splits: Visualizes ticket count % vs. handle dollar % for spreads, totals, and moneylines to detect sharp steam and reverse line movements (RLM).
1 Game with 1 Multi-Leg Strategy: Pinpoints the single prime game of the slate (Chiefs @ Lions) with a correlated 3-leg blueprint (+8.7% EV, 92% confidence) and interactive Kelly stake sizing.
Cross-Sport Slate Directory: Primary focus on NFL football with full support for NBA, MLB World Series, NHL, and college games.

title: Lightweight Anonymized Project Traffic & Attention Tracker
summary: Implemented a privacy-first, zero-cookie telemetry tracker for development staff and the site owner to observe real-time project popularity, dwell time, and device distribution across all site tools.

changes.description: Anonymized Traffic & Attention Tracker: Records project views, active dwell time, session counts, and mobile vs. desktop distribution with zero personal data collection.
